title: Dead error-handling branch in listBooks due to variable shadowing
evidence: app.go:103,107,128 — the function-scope `var err error` is never assigned because both `rows, err := db.Query(...)` blocks use `:=`, shadowing it; the trailing `if err == nil` (app.go:149) is therefore always true and the else branch is unreachable.
suggestion: Remove the unused outer `err` and dead if/else, or collapse the two near-identical query paths into one parameterized query.

title: Test URL id-building only works for single-digit IDs
evidence: app_test.go:189,232,278,286,372 build the path with `string(rune('0'+bookID))`, which maps multi-digit IDs to wrong/garbage characters; it passes only because each test uses a fresh in-memory DB where AUTOINCREMENT yields id=1.
suggestion: Use strconv.Itoa(bookID) or fmt.Sprintf("/books/%d", bookID) to build the path.

title: POST/PUT responses omit created/updated fields and re-marshal a partial object
evidence: app.go:190-196 (createBook) and app.go:273-279 (updateBook) return an ad-hoc gin.H rather than the persisted Book, so `created`/`updated` timestamps are absent from the create/update responses (present only on GET/list).
suggestion: Re-select and return the full Book after insert/update for response consistency.
